evidence.observation: The plan says “The project's six standing rules (`.codex/skills/process-phase/references/project.md`) bind every phase” but selects “`uv run ruff check src tests tools`” for all phases. The cited project.md, lines 129–132, requires `uv run ruff check` over the whole repository and says a phase no longer names a narrower file list.
The plan states that “the whole-repository `uv run ruff check` exits 1” in scripts the milestone does not touch. That leaves the binding full lint gate unsatisfied.

concerns.recommendation: Reconcile the plan with the binding lint rule before the plan gate: make the full gate pass, or obtain and record a scoped change to the project rule.
concerns.title: The selected lint gate cannot satisfy the binding phase rule

summary: The phase lint gate conflicts with the binding project rule, so the plan cannot establish completion under its stated gates.
